name: Work/coding agent platform with desktop/web app

mentions.name: Work/coding agent platform with desktop/web app
mentions.description: A hosted work/coding agent platform: a server-hosted backend paired with a desktop/web app that manages users, permissions, and tasks between human users and coding agents. It would let the non-profit client access incoming data files, diagnose data issues, generate tasks for the coding agent for review, and email property managers about missing data, with a companion desktop/web app for property managers to manage their data at the source. Intended to grow into a larger AI-enabled product for property managers.
mentions.problem: Incoming property data exports (Entrata, Yardi, Excel/CSV) are often missing or poorly managed upstream, requiring manual diagnosis before coding fixes can be tasked to the agent.
mentions.audience: A non-profit consulting client's staff managing the compliance software, with property managers as eventual users
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building a work/coding agent with my consulting client(s) in mind.
mentions.author: brainless
